data.body: Every other AWS CLI call in this publish loop (`list-layer-versions`, `get-layer-version`, `add-layer-version-permission`, `get-layer-version-policy`) redirects stderr with `2>&1` and echoes the captured output before the `::warning::`/`::error::` annotation, so a maintainer sees the real AWS error. `aws lambda publish-layer-version` is the only call missing `2>&1`: on failure `$PUBLISH_RESULT` stays empty and only the generic "Failed to publish the layer in ${REGION}" message is emitted, losing the actual cause (throttling, quota limits, an unsupported `--compatible-runtimes java25` value, a permissions error, etc.) during a real release. Add `2>&1` to the command substitution and echo the captured output to stderr before emitting the warning, matching the pattern used by the surrounding calls.
